Day 2 - Excursion and Symposium Closure

Thursday, 4 February 2027
08:00 – 14:00

Excursion to Mount Kenya GAW station

Mount Kenya National Park

Leave from the hotel at 08:00 and return by 14:00. The excursion will include a short hike from Old Moses Camp to the GAW station (45'), a visit and explanations on site, and an opportunity to observe the local flora and fauna on the way. A light lunch will be served at the station
